term: prediction from finite data versus a global law
definition: PredictionTest contrasts arbitrary finite agreement of two infinite binary sequences with their differing next values. A separately granted global constant-value law implies its instances. Logical underdetermination is not a denial of fallible or probabilistic prediction.
note: Explicit analytical interface for issue #270. Source support and its limits are separately recorded in the linked source claims and docs/hume-regularity.md. Stronger metaphysical identifications require further argument.
